properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 13 at 2:14PM MST until September 13 at 5:15PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued September 13 at 5:13PM EDT until September 13 at 6:00PM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
SMWMLB

The National Weather Service in Melbourne has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Sebastian Inlet to Jupiter Inlet 0-20 nm...

* Until 600 PM EDT.

* At 511 PM EDT, strong thunderstorms were located over inland Saint
Lucie county with gusty outflow surging ahead toward the coast,
near Indrio, moving northeast at 15 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, suddenly higher
waves, lightning and heavy downpours. Make sure all on
board are wearing life jackets. Return to safe harbor if
possible.

* Locations impacted include...
Indrio, Saint Lucie Airport, Queens Cove, Lakewood Park, and Saint
Lucie Village.
properties.instruction: Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 13 at 3:43PM EDT until September 13 at 7:00PM EDT by NWS Upton NY
properties.description:
...Observed flooding changed to Minor severity and increased in
duration for the following rivers in New Jersey...

Saddle River near Lodi affecting Bergen County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring.

* WHERE...Saddle River near Lodi.

* WHEN...Until this evening.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 3:30 PM EDT Sunday the stage was 6.6 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 5.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 3:30 PM EDT Sunday was 6.8 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage this
evening and continue falling to 2.4 feet early Wednesday
afternoon.
- Flood stage is 5.5 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 6.6
feet on 06/19/1972.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this evening at 700 PM EDT.

Northwestern Franklin County in northern New York...

* At 532 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Bombay, or 9
miles east of Massena International Airport - Richards Field,
moving east at 20 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Malone Village, Burke Village, Fort Covington, Westville, Bangor,
Moira, Bombay, Constable, Malone, Burke, Brasher, Fort Covington
Center, Westville Center, North Bangor, South Bombay, Akwesasne

properties.instruction:
Continuous cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Lightning is one of nature's leading killers. Remember, if you can
hear thunder, you are close enough to be struck by lightning.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.
